462ea6c562eb01fc.description: About the Role Ahlan Cyber is seeking an experienced Senior Security Architect to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on designing, implementing, and governing enterprise security architectures, with a strong emphasis on NCA compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Network Security. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing security frameworks, conducting architecture reviews, and ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and enterprise security standards. Key Responsibilities Design and review enterprise security architectures in alignment with NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) and other applicable regulatory frameworks. Architect and oversee network security solutions, including firewalls, WAF, VPN, network segmentation, Zero Trust, and intrusion prevention systems. Design and implement DLP strategies to protect sensitive information across endpoints, networks, email, and cloud environments. Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, and security gap analyses. Define security policies, technical standards, and reference architectures aligned with business and compliance requirements. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and SOC teams to integrate security controls into enterprise environments. Evaluate security technologies, lead proof-of-concept exercises, and provide technical guidance on solution implementation. Support security audits, compliance assessments, remediation activities, and risk reporting. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in security architecture, with demonstrated expertise in NCA compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Network Security. Skills and Expertise Strong understanding of NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC). Proficiency in designing and implementing network security solutions. Expertise in developing and deploying Data Loss Prevention (DLP) strategies. Ability to conduct comprehensive security architecture reviews and risk assessments. Experience in defining security policies and technical standards. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

465853f4049760f9.description: Job Purpose: The Electrician will be responsible for installing and maintaining electrical systems in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Job Responsibility: - Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, fixtures, and equipment. - Inspect electrical components to identify hazards and ensure compliance with local codes. - Test electrical systems and continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. - Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical issues, taking corrective actions to ensure safety and functionality. - Collaborate with other team members to complete projects in a timely manner. Candidate Requirements: - Proven experience as an Electrician. - Knowledge of electrical systems and understanding of electrical codes. - Ability to read technical diagrams and blueprints. - Excellent troubleshooting skills. - Attention to detail and safety precautions. - Physical ability to perform tasks such as lifting heavy equipment and working in various conditions. - Certification as an Electrician is a plus.

4670b48716907be0.description: About Indra Group and the Role Indra Group is a leading company in the defense and technology sector, focused on developing technology solutions for national and international security. The company relies on robust and highly available IT systems and infrastructure to support its global operations. We are seeking a Systems Engineer Infrastructure & Applications Support to join our team in Saudi Arabia, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience in IT systems administration and maintenance. Role Overview The Systems Engineer will be responsible for the administration and maintenance of installed IT systems and infrastructure. This includes managing and monitoring systems to ensure high availability and executing both preventive and corrective maintenance activities. The role is critical for maintaining the operational integrity of our IT environment. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure to ensure high availability. Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, application software, and system management tools. Monitor and test application performance, identify potential bottlenecks, and collaborate with developers on solutions. Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution. Execute maintenance duties according to the maintenance plan, including preventive procedures and schedules. Inspect and verify the status of assets and spare parts, performing corrective maintenance, repairs, and adjustments as needed. Submit maintenance checklist reports in accordance with work orders and maintenance plans. Troubleshoot issues by consulting as-built documents, schematics, and other relevant sources. Coordinate with Systems ML1 engineers to resolve incidents and analyze root causes. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of solid experience in IT systems administration and maintenance. Demonstrated ability to manage and monitor complex IT systems and infrastructure. Proficiency in installing, configuring, and maintaining operating systems and application software. Experience with performance monitoring and troubleshooting. Work Environment and Company Culture Indra Group offers a stable work environment with long-term projects within a leading defense company comprising over 65,000 professionals. The role involves working in an international setting on projects with national and global impact. The company fosters a close-knit, transparent environment with direct communication and a collaborative culture. Professionals are given autonomy and responsibility, with tailored career plans designed for professional growth and development. Indra Group is committed to promoting respectful and dignified work environments, ensuring equal opportunities, and providing a workplace free from discrimination. About Indra Group Indra Group is a Top Employer 2026 certified company, recognized for its comprehensive HR management and the conditions offered to its professionals. The company is dedicated to strengthening national and international security through cutting-edge technology solutions.

4683696ae815085c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فن المعمار السعودية للصيانة عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التزام المنتجات بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة من خلال الفحص والتحليل المستمر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى مراقب الجودة مسؤولية جمع عينات المنتجات وفحصها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى مراجعة سياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومراقبتها. يهدف الدور إلى تحديد مصادر العيوب وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لتحسين جودة المنتجات والعمليات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات تصنيع من مراحل مختلفة من عملية التصنيع، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات منتجات عملية التصنيع، والتحقق من الالتزام بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة. توثيق النتائج التي يتم التوصل إليها من خلال عمليات الفحص والتحليل. تحديد مصادر العيوب في المنتجات أو العمليات، ووضع التوصيات للتخفيف من آثارها. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة وفقاً للمتطلبات والمعايير الجديدة. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة حول اتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها بدقة. معرفة بسياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومعاييرها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يعمل مراقب الجودة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة في جميع مراحل التصنيع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

46d24d2ac9f3fca9.description: About the Role Trading and Development Partnership is seeking a Testing and Commissioning Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves critical work in the testing and commissioning of high-voltage substations and related systems. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Perform testing and commissioning of EHV/HV substations up to 380/400kV. Commission primary equipment including Transformers, GIS/AIS Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, CTs, VTs, Cables, and Busbars. Execute protection relay testing, logic verification, interlock checks, and end-to-end testing. Test and commission SCADA, RTU, SAS, communication, and IEC 61850 systems. Prepare commissioning procedures, test reports, and energization plans. Coordinate with clients, utilities, vendors, and construction teams. Lead energization activities and support final handover. Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and utility standards. Required Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in the testing and commissioning of electrical substations and associated systems. The ability to manage complex technical tasks and coordinate with various stakeholders is essential. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role involves working within a team environment, collaborating with internal and external parties to ensure successful project delivery. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

46ff72970a27dceb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة المخزون بفعالية، بما في ذلك استلام المواد وفحصها وتخزينها وصرفها، مع الحفاظ على سجلات دقيقة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع أقسام المشتريات والإنتاج لضمان توفر المواد ومنع النقص، مما يساهم في كفاءة وسلامة عمليات المستودع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديث سجلات المخزون ومتابعة مستوياته بشكل دوري، وتنفيذ عمليات الجرد لضمان دقة البيانات. فحص المواد الواردة والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات، ثم تخزينها بأمان ووفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. صرف المواد للفرق المعنية وتوثيق حركة الصرف بدقة لضمان تتبع المخزون. تحديث أنظمة المخزون وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير اللازمة حول حركة المواد ومستوياتها. الالتزام بجميع متطلبات السلامة والجودة المعمول بها في المستودع لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام المشتريات والخدمات اللوجستية والإنتاج لمنع أي نقص في المواد وضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتحديث السجلات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والجودة في بيئة المستودعات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور العمل في بيئة مستودع، مع التركيز على الدقة والتنسيق الفعال مع الأقسام الأخرى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

46dd92c601660d09.description: At Wittify.ai , we're building intelligent conversational AI agents that help businesses transform customer interactions, automate operations, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and customer records in the CRM. Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Technical teams to deliver compelling customer solutions. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities within the Saudi technology landscape. Proven experience selling SaaS products, AI solutions, automation platforms, or enterprise technology solutions . Demonstrated experience in the Saudi Arabian market, with a solid understanding of its B2B sales environment. A track record of achieving sales targets and converting prospects into paying customers. Fluent Arabic and strong English communication skills are mandatory. Experience managing the sales cycle, presenting solutions, negotiating, and closing deals. Hands-on experience with CRM platforms. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. A proactive, target-driven mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

46603bfc00c3f681.description: Job description Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Posting Date : 15/10/2026 Ref : ITKSA114 Position : Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Location : KSA City : Riyadh Sector : Hospitality Years of Experience 5–7 years of engineering/facilities maintenance experience with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Certifications: Professional engineering license, FM/Asset Management training, or energy management certifications are desirable. Technical Skills & Tools: Deep knowledge of MEP systems , HVAC, plumbing, and building infrastructure. Practical hands-on expertise with CAFM / CMMS and BMS / Building Automation . Familiarity with energy audits, contractor management, and data-driven/IoT maintenance practices. Competencies & Languages: Leadership & Communication: Strong people manager capable of leading multidisciplinary teams and communicating effectively with both executive staff and technical workers. Analytical Problem-Solving: Root-cause diagnostic mindset with an ability to translate technical issues into actionable solutions. Languages: Professional English required; Arabic preferred (for workforce and contractor coordination). Work Environment: Hands-on operational role requiring regular site presence across compound facilities, plant rooms, workshops, and outdoor infrastructure. Occasional availability outside normal working hours may be required for critical failures or emergencies. Compensation & Benefits: Competitive base salary with housing and transportation allowances/benefits. Comprehensive medical insurance, annual flight benefits, and annual leave in accordance with company policy and Saudi Labor Law. End-of-service benefits and opportunities for professional growth in smart building technologies and asset management. 4682aa94a6aa33a9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حبوب القهوة المحدودة عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين ووضع سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات ذات الصلة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة حبوب القهوة المحدودة.

46a66d3d6b0def1a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الغزالي للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية جمع البيانات المتعلقة بالمنتجات، وبناء علاقات مع العملاء، وإتمام عمليات البيع، ومتابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات التفصيلية المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين والحاليين، سواء عبر الهاتف أو الزيارات الميدانية، لتقديم عروض البيع. عرض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية بوضوح للعملاء. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة. إتمام عمليات البيع، وتحرير الفواتير اللازمة، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وتحصيل الديون. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

46ba636e1eca1378.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Lead Services Specialist Commissioning for a full-time position in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This role is responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of hardware and software products within the DCS Controls Services Business portfolio. The specialist will provide daily or weekly updates on job progress to clients, plant/utility owners, or construction firms as needed. Provide technical direction and support to customers on Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) packaged products. Understand PLC ladder logic, including basic navigation through ladder rungs for troubleshooting. Trace through software documentation and implement DCS control constant modifications. Read and modify software sequencing, and set up/modify hardware/software associated with DCS of BOP, Gas, and Steam Turbine systems. Troubleshoot existing DCS Control hardware and software installations on-site. Prepare field services jobs and coordinate with project/service managers. Provide informal and formal training to customer employees as needed. Supervise cable laying, Insulation Resistance (Megger) testing, and connections. Maintain accurate timesheets and acquire customer signatures before leaving job sites. Prepare Field Service Reports within one week of job completion. Understand Terms and Conditions (T&C) commitments and ensure contractual obligations are met. Provide timely and accurate internal and external reports and attend technical meetings with customers. Ensure all in-field activities comply with company environmental, health, and safety (EHS) guidelines and procedures. Provide expert consultation on complex projects and input hours, expenses, and timesheets accurately in internal systems. Conduct pre-outage and installation planning, potentially recommending and administering policies and procedures. Drive customer satisfaction through a commitment to quality and support business growth initiatives. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to review plant engineering documents and P&IDs. Experience in troubleshooting plant systems and equipment. Proficiency in planning, organizing, integrating, and directing resources (labor, tools, materials) to complete work scopes according to contractual requirements. Knowledge and skill to actively support an outage and identify resources for problem-solving. Familiarity with instruments, controls, and PLCs for controls training. Familiarity with computer network systems and switches. Strong knowledge in synchronous machine control philosophy, Generators, and their auxiliaries. Desired Characteristics Knowledge of EX2100e is an advantage. Excellent written and oral communication skills to convey technical concepts to both business and technical personnel. Ability to work under pressure and take ownership of onsite activities. Willingness to travel, both domestically and internationally, and to work overtime. Strong computer skills using MS Office Software Suite.

465cc74f92e9f587.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable. Every Salla store runs on one storefront. When a buyer searches, opens a product, or reads a review, they decide whether to trust a store they may have never heard of. Every change you ship reaches thousands of stores at once. We are looking for a Product Manager who builds with curiosity, clarity, and care. You own search, the product page, and reviews: how buyers find what they want, decide, and trust what they read. You work side by side with our data and AI teams and turn their models into decisions buyers feel and merchants see in their sales. Core Responsibilities: Know Salla's buyers: how they shop across very different stores, and what makes them hesitate, compare, or leave. Bring their voice into every decision, along with the merchants whose sales depend on it. Own search, the product page, and reviews end to end, from discovery to iteration, tied to buyer conversion and merchant sales. Partner with data and AI teams on ranking, query understanding, and semantic search. Decide what ships, to which stores, and how you measure it. Design the product page around the buyer's decision: what they need to see, trust, and confirm before they buy. Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews. Experiment by default and Ship safely across thousands of stores: staged rollouts, experiments, guardrails, and a way back. Run continuous discovery: talk to buyers and merchants regularly, watch real sessions, and test ideas with prototypes before committing engineering time. Make decisions with data: define the metrics that matter for each surface, read the funnel yourself, and let evidence, not opinion, settle debates. 4–6 years of experience in Product Management , preferably owning Search, Discovery, Product Pages, Conversion, or other customer-facing product experiences within a live consumer or e-commerce product. Proven experience driving product metrics and business outcomes , with the ability to explain what changed, why it changed, and how the impact was measured. AI-native mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools for data analysis, prototyping, research and interpreting product results. Experience working closely with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on Search, Ranking, or Recommendation with a clear understanding of product ownership and decision-making responsibilities. Hands-on experience conducting User Research and Product Experiments, using insights to influence product decisions. Strong understanding of Arabic Search and Discovery , including Arabic spelling variations, dialects, transliteration, Arabic-English mixed queries, and search behavior. Demonstrated ownership of product outcomes , with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment. You simplify: you cut before you add. Fluent in Arabic and English , both written and spoken. Preferred: Experience building a product, feature, or business from 0-to-1 , either as a founder, early-stage team member, or founding product team member.
